scientific_claim: Completed-hour normalized signed aggressive taker quote imbalance contains incremental information about the next completed-hour return beyond recent return and realized-volatility controls.
claim_boundary: Predictive association / incremental forecast information only. No causal order-flow claim, strategy edge, Router, Qnty, trading, capital, signing, or promotion authority.
mechanism: Aggressive buyers and sellers reveal short-lived demand pressure that may persist into the immediately following hour after controlling for recent price movement and volatility state.

source_contract.bar_identity: Provider kline open time identifies the one-hour candle; only fully completed candles are admissible.

prospective_window.origin_definition: Each origin t is the close of a completed 1h candle. Features use information available no later than that close; the outcome is the immediately following completed-hour return.

feature_contract.name: signed_taker_quote_imbalance
feature_contract.domain: [-1,1] when provider fields are internally consistent

control_contract.r24_t: log(close_t / close_{t-24}) using only completed bars through t
control_contract.rv24_t: sqrt(sum of squared hourly log close-to-close returns over the 24 completed returns ending at t))

outcome_contract.name: next_hour_return
outcome_contract.overlap_policy: Hourly outcomes may be adjacent but each origin owns exactly one next-hour candle once.

primary_model.formula: next_hour_return ~ signed_taker_quote_imbalance + r1_t + r24_t + rv24_t + symbol_fixed_effects

conditions: at least 4 of 5 symbol-specific diagnostic slopes are > 0
each symbol has at least 90% of its 2880 scheduled origins valid
no single symbol contributes more than 35% of absolute pooled feature x outcome covariance
